Stellungnahmen zu technischen Grundsatzfragen erstellst du, entwickelst Betriebskonzepte und koordinierst spezielle Systeme wie das Netzvorhersagesystem. The individual in this role will support the development, implementation, and monitoring of compliance policies and procedures aligned with regulatory and legal requirements. Day-to-day responsibilities include tracking changes in relevant regulations, reviewing internal processes and documentation, preparing compliance reports, and assisting in internal audits. Monitor carrier authority, insurance and compliance status. Coordinate with operations and dispatch teams to ensure carriers meet onboarding requirements. We look forward to connecting with talented individuals who are passionate about building reliable and compliant freight operations. Team CMZ.
